semantic_findings: Raw RTC YY 00..99 and modulo-4 leap rule, independent weekday 1..7, no UTC/century/timezone/leap-seconds policy, and natural year99->00 setting-domain preservation are translated faithfully.

RTC transferred counts occurrences: success 1 and otherwise 0. It is not described as byte progress. LPTIM uses 1..65536 ticks and final observed progress; a complete 65536-shot counter zero is not completion evidence.
Declared tick_hz remains a declared fixed unit rate, not measured oscillator accuracy. Core absolute monotonic deadlines remain separate from RTC calendar and LPTIM ticks.

ACCEPTED retains the complete immutable caller request through final acquire-observed SETTLED and external control/observer joins. Cancellation, timeout, stop, held withdrawal and sampled flags do not revoke borrowing.

Host model advancement, public observation, first terminal cause and final detachment/publication remain separate. Cancel/stop can publish after real withdrawal; service is not falsely made the sole publisher.

Construct-once and explicit private reopen preserve stable identity, calendar/set-unset, declared rate, copied clock binding and external hold. Retained responsibility has BUSY priority. UINT64_MAX exhaustion and reserved final LPTIM generation increment do not permit reset or loan abandonment.

Cold static factory lookup and ordinary rtc/lptim sections use existing ControllerIR/provider/factory/Platform assembly. No parallel configuration namespace, runtime discovery, worker, queue, scheduler or mandatory OS adapter is introduced by translation.

Native-only software evidence remains distinct from H743/U575 providers, ARM execution, STOP/VBAT/backup retention, MCU oscillator accuracy, clean publishable SDK, whole-repository CI and HIL qualification.
